summary: First real #645 shadow/simulate gate: classify action impact, ShadowReport previews (cost/side-effects/gates), gate_high_impact requiring shadow_ack+approval for high/critical, MCP plate_autonomy_simulate + gh plate autonomy --simulate.
migration_impact: New MCP tool plate_autonomy_simulate and CLI flag --simulate. High-risk procedures at low risk_tolerance return status=shadow_required instead of executing. No breaking config changes.
migration_guidance: 1. Upgrade plate_core / gh-plate / plate-mcp to pick up autonomy simulate surfaces.
2. Before deploy/release_cut/auto_merge: call plate_autonomy_simulate (or --simulate) and present ShadowReport to the human.
3. Only execute after shadow_ack + approved=True for critical actions; high-risk procedures honor the same gate at low tolerance.
agent_notes: Prefer plate_autonomy_simulate before high-impact autonomy. Do not treat dry_run alone as sufficient for critical actions. Worktree/fork full shadow diffs remain follow-up under #645.
